        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the file type version.
        /// </summary>
        // vpkstuff patch: open the setter so a compiled resource can be AUTHORED
        // rather than framed from a donor. Version is the only header field
        // Serialize() writes that Read() alone can supply, so a private setter is
        // exactly what forces every from-scratch author to find a template file of
        // the right type first. Nothing else about the header is donor-specific:
        // Serialize writes fileSize, KnownHeaderVersion (12), Version, the constant
        // 8, and the block table it derives from Blocks.
        public ushort Version { get; set; }
